senses.gloss:
ITA-7.2.4.3 gaurīpāṣāṇam गौरीपाषाणम्
White arsenic
Arsenic trioxide (As2O3). Duly processed gauripashanam is employed as a stand-alone medicine or as an ingredient in the preparation of polyherbo-mineral pharmaceutical formulations.

ITA-3.14.6 gauryaḥsirāḥ गौर्यः सिराः
Lymphatic vessels
